subject.title: Generalize post-timeout compaction completion reconciliation across session state

question: Should OpenClaw promote the count-only late-success repair into a shared compaction-completion reconciliation boundary, and which session fields should that boundary own?
rationale: The remaining work affects session-store ownership, status/token snapshots, activity timestamps, and possibly plugin/context-engine reporting, so automation should not choose the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design the boundary first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design item and define field ownership plus monotonic/idempotent semantics before implementation.

options.title: Track only narrow bugs
options.body: Leave the count repair as-is and handle each stale status, token, plugin, or activity field through separate narrower issues.

options.title: Declare current scope sufficient
options.body: Close the broad follow-up if maintainers intentionally want only the current count reconciliation and no shared completion boundary.

recommendation.title: Design the boundary first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design item and define field ownership plus monotonic/idempotent semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They co-authored and reviewed the precursor repair and are tied to adjacent context-engine compaction accounting seams.
